A selection from the gallery

Begin with what moves you.

The Language Between Us

Generations reach toward a single glowing seed beneath the branches of an ancient tree, their faces and hands woven into one pattern. Cubist-style wall art about heritage, family, and the language we pass between us.

Explore in the gallery →

She Carries Tomorrow

A mother carries her sleeping child through a quilted landscape of homes, gardens, and city towers while a golden sun rises behind her. Cubist-style wall art about legacy, hope, and the future one family holds in its arms.

Explore in the gallery →

Passing the Brush

An elder places a paintbrush in a young hand while generations of faces look on in fractured light. Cubist art about legacy, mentorship, and the gift of passing the craft forward.

Explore in the gallery →

Generations Around the Table

Elders, parents, and children share fruit and conversation in fractured planes of gold, blue, and crimson. A cubist portrait of family, memory, and the meal that holds a lineage together.

Explore in the gallery →

One Garden, Many Hands

Neighbors of every age kneel in the soil together, tending tomatoes and greens beneath a rising sun. A cubist celebration of community, harvest, and the work we do side by side.

Explore in the gallery →

We Are the Continuation

Generations rise together beneath the ancestral sun in one unbroken portrait of heritage. This powerful work honors family, protection, wisdom, and the legacy we carry forward.
